signature_length_bytes.meaning: length in bytes of the signature presented for validation (77 with time-bound suffix, 65 after truncation)

suffix_present.meaning: whether the 12-byte validUntil/validAfter time-bound suffix is present on the signature

attacker_intercepted_signature.meaning: whether an attacker or malicious bundler intercepted the 77-byte signature

executed_outside_time_bounds.meaning: whether the transaction is executed at a time outside the user's validUntil/validAfter bounds (held and executed at any future time)

assumptions: The 77-byte signature carries the user's validUntil and validAfter time bounds in its 12-byte suffix.
The attacker's interception and truncation occur before the contract validates the signature.

unresolved.description: Report does not give concrete validUntil/validAfter values or the user's intended deadline, so the bound is represented only by the qualitative executed_outside_time_bounds observable.
Report states future-time execution is potential and does not establish a concrete observed on-chain execution.

limitations: The impact is potential; the plan encodes the forbidden outcome as an observable Boolean rather than a concrete executed transaction.
Concrete time-bound values are not reported and are deferred to code binding.
